summary: HtaccessGeneratorTest verified. summary: WP-001: HtaccessGeneratorTest assertion corrections are clean and correct. test_defaultRewriteBaseConstant asserts '' (the actual constant value) and test_getContent_defaultRewriteBase asserts the RewriteBase directive is entirely absent from output when the default is empty. Both changes are semantically accurate and align with the production class behaviour. The test_setRewriteBase_affectsContent test at line 114 also validates the inverse case (that '/api/' does NOT appear when a different base is set), which gives good coverage of the empty-default contract. Minimal change principle followed — only the two assertions that were wrong were altered.

comments.note: test_getContent_returnsNonEmptyString makes two equivalent assertions (assertNotEmpty and assertGreaterThan(0, strlen(...)). The strlen check is redundant with assertNotEmpty in PHP context. Non-blocking — acceptable in test code.
